answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 168098 Country: India Title: Better name choice according to Islam / Quran Question: I am blessed with a baby girl. Alhamdulillah, I want to name her. I am confused between the names ‘Zara’ , ‘Zarah’ or ‘Zahra’. Please help me in choosing a better name out of above mentioned names for her in context of Islam/Quran and meaning wise as well. Answer ID: 168098 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 523/472/M=05/1440) You may keep the name of daughter as Zahra. Here are some other names: Hafsah, Maimuna, Khansa, Atikah, Ayesha, Sadia. You may also choose any of them. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
